title: Early Restrictive or Liberal Fluid Management for Sepsis-Induced Hypotension
shortTitle: CLOVERS: fluids first, or earlier vasopressors?
summary: CLOVERS randomized 1,563 adults after initial fluid resuscitation to a restrictive strategy prioritizing vasopressors or a liberal fluid strategy. Death before discharge home by day 90 occurred in 14.0% versus 14.9% (difference -0.9 percentage points; 95% CI -4.4 to 2.6; P=0.61).
whyItMatters: The trial did not demonstrate a mortality advantage for either strategy after initial fluids; it does not resolve management before resuscitation.
limitations: Unblinded and stopped for futility. Patients had already received 1-3 L; results do not establish equivalence or apply to all shock states.
population: Adults with sepsis-induced hypotension after 1-3 L of IV fluid, across 60 US centers.
intervention: Restrictive fluids with earlier vasopressors over 24 hours
comparator: Liberal fluids before vasopressors over 24 hours
primaryEndpoint: Death before discharge home by day 90
evidenceNotes: Abstract reviewed; open-access full text linked for further appraisal.
